name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  property-tests:
    name: Property-based Tests (Hypothesis)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest hypothesis
          # Install the package itself in editable mode or as needed
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f setup.py ]; then pip install -e .; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run property-based tests
        run: |
          # Run hypothesis tests specifically
          # Adjust the path to your tests directory as needed
          pytest tests/ -m "hypothesis" -v --tb=short || true
          # If no specific marker, run all tests that might use hypothesis
          pytest tests/ -v --tb=short

  atheris-fuzzing:
    name: Atheris Fuzzing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    # Only run on main branches to save CI time
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install atheris
          # Install the package itself
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f setup.py ]; then pip install -e .; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run Atheris Fuzzing
        run: |
          # Find fuzz targets and run them for a short duration (60 seconds)
          # Adjust the path to your fuzz targets as needed
          find . -name "fuzz_*.py" -type f | while read fuzzer; do
            echo "Running fuzzer: $fuzzer"
            timeout 60 python "$fuzzer" || true
          done

      - name: Upload crash artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fuzz-crashes
          path: |
            **/crash-*
            **/timeout-*
          retention-days: 5
